verdict.rationale: Notte documents encrypted vault storage for passwords and secrets, and states the LLM never sees the actual credentials during agent execution. Its docs show agents logging in with stored credentials (e.g., LinkedIn), and its identities feature provides emails and phone numbers for 2FA. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP secret storage and automatic TOTP code generation in the vault, a documented end-to-end login flow handling a 2FA challenge, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
